page.overview:
What is Holiday Animatronics?

The Holiday animatronics are a set of Christmas-themed animatronic counterparts which have exclusively appeared as marketable Five Nights at Freddy's products since their debut in Winter 2023 by Funko Inc.

Santa Freddy is Freddy Fazbear's counterpart wearing a Santa outfit. Notably, his bowtie, freckles, nose, and inner ear are colored red and he has rosy-red cheeks. He is available as a plush toy, figure, and Funko POP!

Elf Bonnie is Bonnie the Rabbit's counterpart wearing a green elf-like outfit. His hat has ear holes, allowing his large rabbit-like ears to peek through, his eyes are a purple, and he holds a red-and-white candy cane. He is available as a plush toy, figure, and Funko POP!

Snow Chica is Chica the Chicken's counterpart with the appearance of a anthropomorphic snowman. She has a red-and-white cap and scarf, three coal as buttons placed vertically on her chest, two more as eyes, and several more as teeth, messily-placed green eyebrows, blue, fingerless gloves, and an endo made of wood. She is available as a plush toy, figure, and Funko POP!
